titleEn: Puro H 3000: Pöttinger’s first maize planter
titleZh: Pöttinger推出首款玉米播种机Puro H 3000
summaryZh: 奥地利农机制造商Pöttinger首次进军播种机市场，推出Puro H 3000气力式播种机，适用于玉米和甜菜等作物。该机可选配电动驱动，支持区段控制和变量播种，配备1300升肥料箱和68升种子箱，完全通过Isobus控制。首批交付预计在2026年底，2027年全面量产，后续还将推出更大机型。
featuredReason: Pöttinger作为欧洲领先农机品牌首次进入播种机市场，其电动驱动和Isobus全控制方案代表了精准农业在播种环节的最新应用趋势，对关注大田作物智能化的从业者具有参考价值。

This is the first time Pöttinger has developed and marketed a planter for crops including maize and sugar beet. According to the manufacturer, the Puro H 3000 is a standard machine intended to compete with the most common machines offered by its competitors. For the first time, Pöttinger is developing a robust maize planter before launching a high-end machine. Electric drive optional The Puro H 3000 maize planter is suitable for sowing at forward speeds of up to 8.5 kilometres per hour, both on ploughed land and in fields with crop residues. Various discs are available, with disc pressure of up to 180 bar and double-disc coulters. The maize planter can optionally be equipped with electric drive. This also enables the use of section control and variable seed rates. The machine also has a fertiliser hopper with a capacity of 1,300 litres. Each sowing unit has a 68-litre seed hopper. The machine is controlled entirely via Isobus. First deliveries at the end of 2026 The first model in the Puro series is a mounted 6-row machine with a working width of up to 4.5 metres and row spacing of up to 75 centimetres. The sowing units slide inwards for transport. According to Pöttinger, the first production models will be delivered at the end of 2026. Full series production will begin in 2027. No pricing information has yet been announced. Larger models from 2029 Pöttinger is also working on larger versions within the Puro series. These are the Puro 5000 and 7000, which are expected to be available with up to 24 sowing units. These machines are not expected to be launched until 2029 and 2031 respectively. More variants of the Puro 3000 will also follow later. In 2027 and 2028, Pöttinger intends to introduce various rigid models with up to 12 rows. translationZh:
奥地利机械制造商Pöttinger正在打造一款新型气力式播种机Puro H 3000。这是Pöttinger首次开发和销售适用于玉米和甜菜等作物的播种机。据制造商介绍，Puro H 3000是一款标准机型，旨在与竞争对手提供的最常见机型展开竞争。Pöttinger首次先开发一款坚固耐用的玉米播种机，之后再推出高端机型。

**可选电动驱动**

Puro H 3000玉米播种机适用于在犁耕地和有作物残留物的田地中以最高每小时8.5公里的速度进行播种。该机提供多种圆盘可选，圆盘压力最高可达180巴，并配备双圆盘开沟器。该玉米播种机可选配电动驱动，这也使得区段控制和变量播种成为可能。该机还配备一个容量为1300升的肥料箱。每个播种单元配备一个68升的种子箱。整机完全通过Isobus进行控制。

**首批交付于2026年底**

Puro系列的首款机型是一款悬挂式6行机，作业宽度可达4.5米，行距最大可达75厘米。播种单元在运输时向内滑动。据Pöttinger称，首批量产机型将于2026年底交付。全面批量生产将于2027年开始。目前尚未公布定价信息。

**更大机型将于2029年推出**

Pöttinger还在开发Puro系列中更大的版本，即Puro 5000和7000，预计将提供最多24个播种单元。这些机型预计分别要到2029年和2031年才会推出。Puro 3000的更多变体也将陆续推出。在2027年和2028年，Pöttinger计划推出多种刚性机架机型，最多可达12行。
contentHtml: Pöttinger brengt met de Puro H 3000 zijn eerste pneumatische maiszaaimachine op de markt, geschikt voor standaardtoepassingen en elektrische aandrijving.
